verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Marker GitHub claim that it converts documents "in all languages". That is a single broad vendor statement, with nothing specific on CJK or right-to-left scripts and no evidence that non-English output matches English fidelity. missing for 10: explicit CJK support documentation, RTL/bidirectional script handling, multilingual accuracy benchmarks showing parity with English, independent or hands-on corroboration on non-English documents.
